messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square maximizing the minimum triangle area is the 'pinwheel' arrangement: four points at the corners, four points at the midpoints of the sides, and five points in a centered regular pentagonal ring scaled to fit within the inner square, achieving a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/144. This configuration is optimal because any perturbation either creates a collinearity among three nearby points (dropping the minimum to zero) or shrinks at least one of the 286 triangles below this threshold."}
